note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (end of Eduardo Frei Ruiz-Tagle's Concertación government, between the two rounds of the 1999-2000 presidential election), not measured data. The armed forces still held constitutional prerogatives such as designated senators; business and mining exporters are influential; trade unions are weaker than in Argentina; the Catholic Church is influential on social questions.

interest_groups.note: Constitutional prerogatives under the 1980 Constitution until the 2005 reforms.
Business associations and mining and export interests.
